parsed.lean:
theorem probe_centeredBody_nonvacuous : ∃ K : Ehrhart.CenteredBody 0, True := by
  refine ⟨{ carrier := Set.univ
            convex := convex_univ
            compact := isCompact_univ
            fullDimensional := by simp
            centered := Subsingleton.elim _ _
            uniqueInteriorLatticePoint := ?_ }, trivial⟩
  ext z
  have h : z = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst h
  simp [Ehrhart.interiorLatticePoints]
